name: eps-indi-b
label: Epsilon Indi B
method: aperture photometry r=2 px, sky ring 4-7 px; Gaia neighbours within 15" fitted together
note: 453 measurements, one per SPHEREx photo; 102 flagged (16 overloaded: the star is too bright for the camera there); 13 measure only the glow around an overloaded core (shows changes, not total brightness); error bars widened x9.6 to match the real scatter.

variability.text: no change beyond the uncertainty (steady within about 3%)
